title: Finite-subextension to norm-continuous coefficient inclusion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology. On profinite sets with the coherent topology let $C(P)$ be the ring of continuous maps $P\to\Omega$ whose image lies in one finite intermediate field [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and let $B(P)=C(P,\Omega)$ be the ring of all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Define the morphism of sheaves of rings $c:C\to B$ by the sectionwise subring inclusion $f\mapsto f$. Its underlying abelian-sheaf morphism is the corresponding morphism of commutative ring objects [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], with its unit and multiplication compatibility. The section maps commute with restriction by precomposition. This definition asserts no cohomological comparison or flatness.
